verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway documents caching at the gateway through a dedicated AI Semantic Cache plugin, and its docs say the gateway performs caching using semantic-similarity queries, so repeated or similar requests can be served from cache. The evidence is mostly plugin titles and one-line overview statements. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the cost and latency savings, cache configuration details (TTL, storage backend, exact-match vs semantic thresholds), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can cache responses at the gateway to cut cost and latency on repeated requests

citations.quote: AI Gateway can perform intelligent request routing, caching, and content filtering using semantic similarity queries.
powers LLM workflows like intelligent caching, retrieval, classification, and anomaly detection.
